other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.size:
primrec size :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where
  "size Leaf = 0" |
  "size (Node l x r) = size l + size r + 1"
formal function definitions.subtrees:
fun subtrees :: "'a tree ⇒ 'a tree set" where
  "subtrees Leaf = {Leaf}" |
  "subtrees (Node l a r) = {Node l a r} ∪ subtrees l ∪ subtrees r"
formal function definitions.wbalanced:
fun wbalanced :: "'a tree ⇒ bool" where
  "wbalanced Leaf = True" |
  "wbalanced (Node l x r) = (abs(int (size l) - int (size r)) ≤ 1 ∧ wbalanced l ∧ wbalanced r)"

formal theorem statement: theorem wbalanced_subtrees: "⟦ wbalanced t; s ∈ subtrees t ⟧ ⟹ wbalanced s"
